#1011 · Candy Apple Pokémon

Dipplin

Grass Dragon

Paldea · Generation 9

Dipplin is a Grass/Dragon-type Candy Apple Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 9.7 kg. It evolves from Applin and into Hydrapple. Its highest base stat is Defense (110), with a base stat total of 485.
